Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In the midst of a twisted vortex of fate, 
a new struggle for survival begins! 

 

We are excited to introduce the July Update, 
inspired by Marvel Studios’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

 

As the curtain rises on a new destiny, 
New Uniforms have been added for 
Spider-Man, Hulk, and Scorpion, who are set to clash.
In addition, Scorpion, who possesses the power 
to relentlessly overwhelm enemies with his deadly tail, 
has received his Tier-4 Advancement.

 

Please check below for more details on these and various other improvements designed 
to make your gameplay experience more convenient!

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms


To celebrate Marvel Studios’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day inspired update,
three new uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Spider-Man <Marvel Studios’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day>, Hulk <Marvel Studios’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day>, and Scorpion <Marvel Studios’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day>.  
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <July Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Scorpion Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Scorpion.
Although he gained immense power through biological experimentation, he lost his normal everyday life in return, leaving him with nothing but rage.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Whiplash and Ulysses Klaue Potential Awakening

 

Check out the Potential Awakening abilities 
for Whiplash and Ulysses Klaue, added in the July Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

After the July update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Whiplash and Ulysses Klaue will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[July Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Studios’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals

 

Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 7/28 Maintenance - 8/25 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 7/28 Maintenance - 8/25 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Adjusted the difficulty of certain Shadowland Challenge Mode floors.
- The max HP of Floor 24 boss, Moon Knight, has been slightly reduced.
- The ignore targeting skills used by Floor 25 boss, Namor, have been toned down.

 

2. Added the Custom Gear Upgrade All Feature.
- This feature can be used by checking the "Upgrade All" menu on the bottom right of the screen.
- You can upgrade up to 20 Custom Gears at a time.

 

 

When using the Upgrade All feature, you can customize your upgrades with the following settings.
- If the upgrade stops due to insufficient materials while using the "Auto Upgrade until max grade is reached" option, a "Not enough materials" notification will be displayed.

 

 

3. Improved the Artifact Dismantle Feature.
① Dimension Rift: A feature to automatically dismantle Artifacts acquired within the stage has been added.

 

 

You can adjust detailed options through the Set Auto-Dismantle menu.
* Please be careful when using the "Exclusive Artifact Selection Option", as it is related to dismantling Character-Exclusive Passive Artifacts.
- All Grades: Automatically dismantles all Character-Exclusive Passive Artifacts.
- Below Equipped Grade: Automatically dismantles only Exclusive Artifacts that are of a lower grade than the currently equipped passive skill Artifact.
* Premium / Special / Ultimate Artifact of Change items are excluded from Auto-Dismantle.
* This feature can also be used in Store > Dimension Chest: Artifact.

 

 

The Dismantle Artifact (Auto Select) feature in the Inventory shares the same settings as above, and you can additionally choose whether to use enhanced Artifacts as materials.

 

 

Upon clearing Dimension Rift stages, you can now view the list of dismantled Artifacts and the amount of dismantled Celestial Essence obtained. 

 

 

 

4. Recommended Skill Combo: Added the "Auto Open" feature.
- Applicable Content: World Boss, Dispatch Mission, Giant Boss Raid, Alliance Battle, Legendary Battle, Ranked Battle.

 

 

You can disable "Auto Open" even while inside a stage, and in this case, the setting will only apply to that specific content.

 

 

5. Added a feature to navigate to the Marvel Universe when tapping the "Marvel Universe" button within the Uniform List.

 

 

6. Ranking: Added a Character Name search feature within the Rank per Character menu.

 

 

7. Agent Growth / Welcome Back Training: Added an "Acquire All" button to claim all cleared mission rewards at once.

 

8. Dispatch Shop: Simplified the number of pop-ups displayed when using the "Refresh Now" feature.

 

9. World Event: The "Battle Training" feature has been discontinued.

 

10. Alliance Battle (Training Mode): Improved the system so that the selected round on the preparation screen remains saved even when re-entering the screen.

 

11. Improved the system so that you can no longer sell uncrafted Premium Comic Cards.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. Ranked Battle: Fixed an issue where some Agents did not receive ranking rewards under certain circumstances.
- Based on our records, we will distribute the missing rewards to all affected Agents during the July Update maintenance.
The rewards will only be stored in your Inbox for 3 days from the distribution date, so please claim them before they expire.

[7/29 (Wed) 5:25 (UTC+0), 7/28 (Tue) 22:25 (PDT) added]

Rewards were issued as of 7/29 (Wed) 3:29 (UTC+0), 7/28 (Tue) 20:29 (PDT). 

Please note that they will remain in your inbox for 3 days from the time of issue, 

so be sure to claim them before they expire.


2. Fixed an issue where the faction of certain PVE Bosses was incorrectly applied.
Alliance Battle (Infinite Challenge - Kang the Conqueror): Alien → Human
Giant Boss Raid (Dormammu): Alien → Other

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
